name: agent-sprite-forge
description: Production-oriented 2D game asset workflows for sprites, layered maps, deterministic post-processing, and Cowart canvas handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Generate game-ready 2D maps and sprites, including Cowart handoff.
interface.longDescription: Agent Sprite Forge plans production-oriented map and sprite pipelines, generates raw art with the host image model, runs deterministic cleanup and QC, exports engine-ready bundles, and can return selected previews and sheets to a Cowart canvas.
defaultPrompt: Create a game-ready 2D sprite sheet and return it to Cowart.
Build a layered 2D map bundle and place its preview on Cowart.
Generate and QC a transparent 2D game asset bundle.
